title: Australian Dollar Falls Below Rs. 190 in Pakistan
excerpt: The Pakistani rupee posted ongoing gains while the Australian currency dropped under the Rs. 190 threshold.
body_html:
The Pakistani rupee maintained its upward movement against the US Dollar, marking its 281st consecutive day of closing in the green on Thursday.

Alongside this ongoing trend for the local currency, the Australian dollar experienced a notable decline, dropping to trade below the Rs. 190 mark.
